The Dillusioned Cheese!

August 21, 2006

To Illusion and Me!
It’s about dedications! :)
Thats how we hitted it off! I dedicated a poem and next thing I knew that she was having an evil time with me!
It’s none other then “My Polar Bear”.
I have never had a chance to have one for pet; but better, I got one for friend. Evil to core.

We might not be the best of “chuddy buddies”. We might not be the “call-everyday-discuss-even-fart-smell-pals”. And we might not be the closest of all “dimwits”. But then we are still “Friends”.

Friends who have “beep induced” conversations over “coin phones” from airport. Who bitch about friends, they come out with to celebrate b’day! Who discuss hardcore porn and beat their odd against all, to send bulky files across the mammoth internet. Who plans a savagely plot to beat the crap out of thin guy. Who think, “audibles” on yahoo are pretty cool a thing to irritate and who think that some jokes are never too lame and old to pull off again and again. :)

I really don’t know what I could have done to pep her up; but I know I am on standby for her rescue! After all, am not the one, who’d leave her with eyes red, swollen and burning.

Life is a bitch! So fuckin what??? We are bigger bitches! :D

Hey illusion! am here babe!
I am not exactly a boyfriend material. But doesn;t mean I can’t dedicate stuff to you and you can’t dedicate stuff for me! If no one, then atleast we are there for each other! Arent we! :D

So here goes the mushy dedication to you… and “abso-fuckin-lutely only for you…”
Crash and Burn By Savage Garden
When you feel all alone

Let me be the one you call
